versions.content: swImplPolicy The swImplPolicy indicates the way how a VariableDataPrototype shall be processed at the receiver's side. If set to queued the semantics is that the corresponding VariableDataPrototype needs to be added to a queue (or in other words: a FIFO data structure) from which it is later consumed by the actual receiver software-component.
